statements.status_notes: The airflow compat image ships libmariadb3 from the Debian trixie mariadb source package (1:11.8.6-0+deb13u1). CVE-2026-49261 is fixed in Debian sid (1:11.8.8-1) but no fixed mariadb package is available in Debian trixie yet, so a DHI rebuild cannot remediate this finding until trixie receives the security update.
